title: Portfolio Engine
description: An Apache-2.0 Astro/Tailwind backbone for agent-native personal and professional websites: site owners contribute needs, AI agents implement scoped issues, and humans review the shared foundation.

contact.heading: Contribute to Portfolio Engine
contact.body: Portfolio Engine is looking for Astro developers, Tailwind/design-system reviewers, accessibility reviewers, open-source maintainers, agent-workflow people, and site owners with real recurring needs. Open an issue, review the architecture, test the demo, or propose a reusable capability that should belong in the shared engine.

scheduling.label: Open a GitHub issue
scheduling.heading: Contribute through GitHub
scheduling.description: Use GitHub Issues and pull requests rather than booking a private walkthrough.
